title: Activated carbon @ MIL-101(Cr): a potential metal-organic framework composite material for hydrogen storage
material_description: Activated carbon | commercial microporous activated carbon WS-480 (Chemviron carbon), measured as obtained; the carbon added to MIL-101 to make the AC@MIL-101 composites; Type-I N2 isotherm
source_location: main, p. 751 (main-6.png), Fig. 6, series Activated Carbon, filled down-triangles (adsorption branch)
notes: archive: HYC-0071_fig6_activated_carbon_ads.json. Digitized marker centre at 599.4579945799462 kPa (stored as bar = kPa/100), 2.092682926829265 wt%. Branch: Fig. 6 caption says adsorption-desorption isotherms; legend shows filled symbols only; filled = adsorption and open = desorption follows the same authors' legends in SI Fig. 3a/3b (ads filled, des open). Temperature 77.4 K as stated in Section 2.5 for the H2 measurements (Table I title and Fig. 6 caption print 77 K). Basis not named; BELSORP-HP (BEL Japan) high-pressure gas adsorption system is volumetric, so basis_inferred = excess by instrumental default. Degassing: 1 K/min to 393 K under vacuum (6.7 x 10^-2 Pa), held 10 h (printed 393 K, 6.7 x 10^-2 Pa). Uncertainty: 'The errors in the measurements of hydrogen uptake values were within the range of +/-0.5%' (Section 2.5); unclear whether wt% or relative %, so uncertainty_wt_pct left empty. material_description: Activated carbon | commercial microporous activated carbon WS-480 (Chemviron carbon), measured as obtained; the carbon added to MIL-101 to make the AC@MIL-101 composites; Type-I N2 isotherm
source_location: main, p. 751 (main-6.png), Fig. 6, series Activated Carbon, open down-triangles (desorption branch)
notes: archive: HYC-0071_fig6_activated_carbon_des.json. Digitized marker centre (centroid of the open triangle interior) at 5326.407708521531 kPa (stored as bar = kPa/100), 3.5687185443282994 wt%. Branch: Fig. 6 caption says adsorption-desorption isotherms; legend shows filled symbols only; filled = adsorption and open = desorption follows the same authors' legends in SI Fig. 3a/3b (ads filled, des open). Temperature 77.4 K as stated in Section 2.5 for the H2 measurements (Table I title and Fig. 6 caption print 77 K). Basis not named; BELSORP-HP (BEL Japan) high-pressure gas adsorption system is volumetric, so basis_inferred = excess by instrumental default. Degassing: 1 K/min to 393 K under vacuum (6.7 x 10^-2 Pa), held 10 h (printed 393 K, 6.7 x 10^-2 Pa). Uncertainty: 'The errors in the measurements of hydrogen uptake values were within the range of +/-0.5%' (Section 2.5); unclear whether wt% or relative %, so uncertainty_wt_pct left empty. Free-volume determination not described (He listed only among gases used). BET range not stated; total pore volume by 'single-point adsorption method' (pore_volume_method = other); pore width 0.90 nm by BJH from the desorption isotherm (Section 2.5). isotherm_point_count 46 = markers counted at >= ~474 kPa (23 filled incl. one at ~2.56 MPa largely hidden under an open marker and not extracted, 23 open); markers below ~474 kPa overlap the five MOF/composite series in Fig. 6 and could not be counted, so the run has more than 46 points (lower bound).
